items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: So he signed me up to play for Big Bill Thompson.

ctx.x: Yes, you want to get through there? I'll stop it. Okay, it's going again.
In 24, the colored political boss of the South Side, like Dawson, you've heard of Dawson there? Yes, Mr. Day. Like Dawson yesterday. His name was Dan Jackson. And stop him if you can.
That's all right. Don't worry about it. It just won't pick it up too much.
